remarks: This bright and airy two-bedroom duplex spans two floors, and offers postcard views of Main Street. Completely reimagined in a 2023 gut renovation, this residence blends modern design, comfort and energy efficiency at the highest standards. The contemporary open-concept layout features glistening white oak floors, sun-drenched windows, quartz countertops, a sleek Bosch stainless steel appliance suite, ensuite bedrooms with stylish, spa-like bathrooms, a home office and a charming porch. Recessed lighting throughout enhances the home's sophisticated ambiance. Nestled in a prime heart-of-town location, this exceptional home is just moments from renowned restaurants, boutique shopping, the commuter express train, and all the best in-town amenities.
